name: OWASP_A03_SQLi_InBand_Inferential_OOB_Detection
search: index=web_logs sourcetype="access_combined" OR sourcetype="nginx:plus:access" | eval decoded_payload = lower(urldecode(_raw)) | rex field=decoded_payload "(?union\s+(all\s+)?select|extractvalue\s*\(|updatexml\s*\(|concat\s*\(.*select|group_concat|convert\s*\(.*select|cast\s*\(.*select)" | rex field=decoded_payload "(?sleep\s*\(\d+\)|benchmark\s*\(|waitfor\s+delay|pg_sleep\s*\(\d+\)|and\s+\d+=\d+|or\s+['"]?1['"]?\s*=\s*['"]?1|case\s+when.*then.*else)" | rex field=decoded_payload "(?xp_dirtree|xp_fileexist|utl_http|httpuritype|sys\.dbms_ldap|load_file\s*\(\s*['"]?\\\\)" | where isnotnull(in_band_sqli) OR isnotnull(inferential_sqli) OR isnotnull(oob_sqli) | eval detected_type = case(isnotnull(in_band_sqli) AND isnotnull(oob_sqli), "In-Band & Out-of-Band (OOB) SQLi", isnotnull(in_band_sqli), "In-Band SQL Injection (Union/Error-Based)", isnotnull(inferential_sqli), "Inferential / Blind SQL Injection (Time/Boolean-Based)", isnotnull(oob_sqli), "Out-of-Band (OOB) SQL Injection (DNS/SMB Exfiltration)") | stats count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(detected_type) as attack_category values(uri_path) as targeted_endpoints by src_ip, http_user_agent, status | where count >= 1
description: Detects In-Band (Union/Error), Inferential (Blind Time/Boolean), and Out-of-Band (OOB) SQL Injection attacks.
